data.name: Nagu
data.gender_notes: Nagu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Nagas are serpent deities. 'Nagu' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'naga', meaning 'serpent' or 'cobra'. These deities are considered protectors and givers of life. They are also associated with water, fertility, and medicine. The name Nagu carries the meaning “Serpent, Cobra” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nagu usually hope their child will grow to embody serpent, cobra and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, rebirth, and the power of nature.
data.etymology: Nagu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Serpent, Cobra.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nagu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Nagu, meaning "cobra" in Sanskrit, symbolizes transformation and protection in Hinduism. The cobra represents the destructive power of the universe, which when harnessed, can bring about regeneration and rebirth. Nagu signifies the ability to transcend difficulties and emerge stronger, embodying the spirit of resilience and adaptability.

historical_references.reference: Nagas were a class of divine, semi-divine and demonic serpent beings in Hinduism. The Nagas are often depicted as having the ability to change their forms and shapes, and are associated with water, and the fertility of the earth.

The Naga King, Takshaka, is mentioned in Mahabharata as having the ability to control poison and is considered to be a friend of the Pandava prince, Bhima. He poisons the Kaurava prince, Dushasana, in retaliation for his attack on a Naga queen.

Instagram users frequently share images and stories about Nagas, while Reddit threads explore their significance in Indian culture and mythology. Quora questions and answers delve deeper into their symbolic meanings and various interpretations.
